goodfire.field_naming: resid_to_* and pathmean_* = mean over the 20 waypoints; *_t0 = the t = 0 waypoint; *_t1 = the t = 1 waypoint; carrier offsets = the unedited carriers (the start state before any edit)

zero_edit_baseline.definition: each carrier's UNEDITED context-only meanpool (projected into the context-only PCA-64), held at all 8 waypoints, scored against the same context-only spline / chord (source -> target, both targets averaged) in the carrier's own natural units

data_separation.carriers: each pair's 16 carriers = every probe/test clip at the source value, filled to 16 with seeded knot clips: knot fill per pair [4, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 3, 5] (of 16); test clips per pair [5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5]. The knot clips are also in the PCA / ring fit set (full-clip and context-only).
data_separation.kappa: the von Mises readout concentration kappa was fitted by max likelihood on the TEST clips' unedited forecasts, and test clips are also carriers
data_separation.behaviour_centroids: the behaviour centroids b_v (and so the target spline) used ALL clips at each value (knot + probe + test, carriers included), unedited forecasts
data_separation.readout: the native direction probe (W, b) was fit on probe clips; probe clips are also carriers

ctx_geometry_provenance.pca_fit_set: 632 context-only knot meanpools at the 56 kept values (held-out values excluded)
ctx_geometry_provenance.replaced_basis: top-32 components of the context-only PCA-64
ctx_geometry_provenance.init: chord from the context-only source centroid to the target's context-only spline point, top-32 coordinates at the 20 t's
ctx_geometry_provenance.arc_direction: ctx spline forced to the behaviour target's signed shift (flipped pairs: [False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False, False])
ctx_geometry_provenance.path_representation: carrier-mean edited activation in the context-only PCA-64 (top-32 = the waypoint, PCs 33-64 = the carriers' own); summary_64d_padded_goodfire = causalab zero padding; summary_32d = top-32 truncation
